title: Cookie Policy | Unique Visa Services Ltd
description: How the Unique Visa Services website uses cookies and similar browser storage. We don't use advertising or analytics cookies.
intro: This cookie policy explains what cookies and similar technologies our website uses, and why. The short version: we don't use advertising or analytics cookies, and we don't track you across other websites. Last updated: November 2026.

sections.heading: 1. What cookies are
sections.text: Cookies are small text files a website saves in your browser. Similar technologies, such as session storage, let a page remember information while you use it. We use both only where they're needed for the website to work.

sections.heading: 2. Cookies and storage we use
sections.text:
- Online application forms: while you fill in an application form, your answers are saved in your browser's session storage so you don't lose them if you go back a step or refresh the page. This is cleared when you submit the form, click "Start again" or close the browser tab. It never leaves your device until you submit.
- Client document forms: these remember, for the current browser tab only, that you've entered the access code we gave you.
- Website editor: our own staff who log in to edit the website have a login saved in their browser. Visitors are never affected.

sections.heading: 3. Third-party services
sections.text:
- Google reCAPTCHA: the "I'm not a robot" check on our contact form is provided by Google, which may set cookies and collect information about your device to confirm you're a real person. See [Google's privacy policy](https://policies.google.com/privacy).
- Google Fonts: our pages load fonts from Google, so your browser's IP address is sent to Google when the fonts load. No cookies are set for this.
- Links to other websites: if you click a link to WhatsApp, Google Maps, Trustpilot, social media or a government website, that website's own cookie policy applies.

sections.heading: 4. Analytics and advertising
sections.text: We don't currently use analytics, advertising or tracking cookies. If we add them in future, we'll update this policy and ask for your consent before setting any that aren't essential.

sections.heading: 5. Managing cookies
sections.text: You can block or delete cookies in your browser settings. If you block all cookies, the "I'm not a robot" check on our contact form may not work, so you may need to contact us by phone, email or WhatsApp instead.

sections.heading: 6. More information
sections.text: For how we handle your personal information, see our [privacy policy](/privacy-policy/). If you have any questions, email us at [hello@uvsuk.com](mailto:hello@uvsuk.com).
